identity_assertions.rationale: The hotel and the corporation formed in 1957 to run it (plate 18) are separate entities: the license fight was over Ideal Hotel, Inc.'s license for the hotel.

notes.note: Address: plate 13's caption gives 171 North Main; the post's text (2-p25), the incorporation notice (plate 18) and the 1958 revocation (plate 24) give 173 North Main. Both stand; an open question for step 5.
